title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
MEET DEEPL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.

 

MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY

You will join the Hybrid Platform Engineering track, which builds and operates the compute layer underpinning DeepL's products and research: the Kubernetes control plane, node lifecycle, networking, storage and core cluster services, across both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. Today that spans hybrid infrastructure in Europe - including large on-prem GPU clusters powering DeepL's research and hundreds of on-prem GPU nodes serving production inference - as well as AWS regions across the globe running the product. The track is deepening this hybrid model, unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and AWS to give product and research teams a self-service foundation they can build on.

 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Take ownership of the reliability, capacity and cost efficiency of DeepL's compute infrastructure, CPU and GPU: the hybrid platform serving our products across AWS and on-prem, and the on-prem clusters powering our research, including their hardware lifecycle

- Shape the platform's architecture: bring strong technical positions, weigh them on their merits with your peers, and commit to decisions serving the best outcome

- Design, build and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, taking them from design through to long-term operation

- Drive the technical work of deepening the hybrid model - unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and cloud, especially AWS and supporting research as it adopts cloud-native technology and ways of working

- Define infrastructure-as-code and platform standards that hold across the track, and strengthen observability and security so the platform's behaviour is legible to the teams that depend on it

- Mentor engineers across the infrastructure track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep the platform maintainable

- Build consensus across engineering teams and turn it into shipped change, shaping platform direction at track level

- Lead incident response for hybrid infrastructure, driving remediation through to roo

title: Accounting Manager — AI & Automation
description:
Are you an accounting leader who is obsessed with AI?
We're looking for an experienced accountant who believes AI is going to fundamentally change how accounting gets done - and wants to be at the forefront of that transformation. Arboreal manages more than 10,000 apartments, and we've built our own property-management software platform, Maynard, with extensive APIs and MCP tools that let AI agents work directly in our accounting systems. This role is your chance to prove how much more a great accountant can accomplish when the manual work is handed to AI and the judgment stays with you.
The Role
This is a new kind of accounting role, built for how Arboreal intends to run its accounting function going forward. Rather than managing a team of people, the Accounting Manager oversees the accounting for a book of work primarily through AI agents operating on Maynard in conjunction with AppFolio. The focus is judgment and review: directing and supervising automated workflows, tackling complex reconciliations and investigations with AI, preparing and reviewing journal entries, validating what the agents produce, and standing behind the accuracy of the financials. You'll be one of four Accounting Managers who work side by side to make sure financials go out on time and accurately and that balances are reconciled across the portfolio. A shared pool of accountants performs a limited set of manual tasks and AI-assisted supporting reconciliations; these accountants do not report to this role. You'll have direct access to the CFO, the engineering team, and our AI-enabled accounting tools - and you'll be encouraged to experiment, improve processes, and figure out how much more is possible. This position reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer and spans accounts payable and receivable, corporate accounting, client onboarding and offboarding, and the review of property financials.
Oversee Accounting Through AI Agents & Automation

• Own the accounting for an assigned book of work, executed primarily through AI agents running on Maynard alongside AppFolio - directing, supervising, and quality-controlling their output rather than performing each task by hand.

• Use AI to tackle complex reconciliations, investigate accounting problems, and automate work that traditionally takes hours of manual effort.

• Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations, and review AI- and system-generated entries and reports for accuracy, completeness, proper coding, and compliance with U.S. GAAP before they are relied upon.

• Identify, investigate, and resolve exceptions the agents flag or that review surfaces, and determine when a human needs to step in.

• Experiment with and improve agent workflows, prompts, rules, and controls - partnering with the CFO and engineering team so the system produces reliable results and keeps getting better.

• Act as a knowledgeable check on automation - understanding what the agents are doing well enough to catch when an output is wrong, and never signing off on numbers that have not been verified.

Timely & Accurate Financial Reporting

• Work alongside the other three Accounting Managers to ensure financial statements go out on time and accurately for the assigned portfolio each period.

• Coordinate the close calendar and hand-offs across the manager group so there are no gaps or duplicated work, and so dependencies are met.

• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close and produce financials in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Provide the CFO with variance explanations, supporting schedules, and management reporting for lenders, owners, and external tax preparers and auditors.

Reconciliations & Balance Integrity

• Ensure balance-sheet accounts are reconciled and that balances are supported, reviewing the AI-assisted reconciliations prepared on the platform and by the accountant pool.

title: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany
description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany
Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Germany. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.
The programme
A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.
You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.
What you will work on
Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.
What you bring
8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.
Useful but not essential:
SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We’re looking for an experienced Course Author in Applied AI to help design and develop a graduate-level online program in Applied Artificial Intelligence, delivered in partnership with a US university. The program is built for working professionals in fields such as marketing, operations, finance and HR. They learn to evaluate, build, integrate, deploy and govern AI solutions using modern no-code and low-code tools. You’ll turn approved course syllabi into engaging, rigorous learning materials and help shape how a new generation of AI practitioners learns to make sound, defensible decisions.
This is a part-time, project-based opportunity for subject matter experts who are passionate about teaching, curriculum design and helping learners succeed.

• Revise content based on academic review by the partner university’s faculty, and make sure it meets graduate-level academic standards.

Requirements

• 5+ years of recent professional experience in applied AI/ML, data, AI automation, or a related field, including hands-on experience with LLMs.

• A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field, or 10+ years of senior professional experience in AI or a related industry.

• Practical knowledge of AI tools and workflows, including prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, automation, APIs, and LLM evaluation.

• Experience applying AI to real business problems, considering business value, cost, risk, and reliability.

• Experience teaching, mentoring, or creating educational content, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Strong English communication skills (C1+), including clear professional and educational writing.

• Strong organizational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work proactively, incorporate feedback, and meet agreed deadlines.

Nice-to-have

• Experience designing courses or learning materials for higher education or online programs.

• Familiarity with AI strategy, business cases, or responsible AI practices or governance.

• Experience with EdTech or learning platforms, or contributions to the AI community through publications, talks, or open-source projects.

Washington's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, islands, and coastlines. These organizations often operate with limited resources while carrying an enormous responsibility to the people they serve.

title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI-Native Residential Appraisals for Mortgage Lenders

The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadComparo, an AI-native residential appraisal venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Comparois an AI-native residential appraisal firm built for independent mortgage banks and private lenders. Today, a lender waits 5 to 10 days for an appraisal that takes under an hour of real analytical work. Comparo collapses that to 24 hours. Homeowners or data collectors capture the property with a phone scan, AI selects comparables, runs adjustments and drafts the full report, and a licensed appraiser reviews and signs. Comparo sells the finished, UAD 3.6-compliant appraisal rather than software, so it owns the workflow end to end and captures the full per-report fee. The same engine extends to tax appeals, insurance, estate valuations and continuous portfolio revaluation for lenders and mortgage-backed asset holders.
Market Context
The US residential appraisal industry is an $8.8-11.4B market, with roughly 5 million appraisals completed each year at $400-700 per report. Mortgage appraisals ordered by independent mortgage banks and private lenders represent a $1.5-2.1B serviceable market. The timing is sharp: UAD 3.6 becomes mandatory on November 2, 2026, expanding each report from roughly 700 to 3,600 data fields, while an aging workforce of 75,000-80,000 licensed appraisers shrinks.

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

• Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across fintech, proptech and early-stage capital markets

description:
Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) marwa.hamdi@mines-albi.fr
en collaboration avec Safa Layeb Safa.layeb@mines-albi.fr et Franck Fontanili Franck.fontanili@mines-albi.fr

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

• Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama nel.samama@telecom-sudparis.eu

• Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet marius.huguet@emse.fr

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):
Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning
Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :
L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.
Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.
Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.
Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.
Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.
Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?
Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S - CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage
L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

• Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

• Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

The role, in a nutshell

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain, and we're building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. You'll join a small, fast-moving team building Chainguard Harness.

Chainguard Harness uses frontier AI models to hunt down exploitable vulnerabilities in a customer's application, then delivers validated findings with recommended fixes, with no model access required. Customers trust us with their source code, so security isn't just a feature of this product. It is the product.

As a Staff engineer you'll own large parts of the Harness architecture, guide technical decisions across the team, and help take the product from beta to a service that scales to many more customers and environments.

Own major parts of the system end to end, from design through implementation, rollout, and operation

Build security into the foundation: protecting customer code end to end, least-privilege access, and auditing everything the system and its operators do. Partner with Product and Security on threat models and reviews.

•
Make Harness a reliable, observable, production-grade service, making sound long-term tradeoffs around scale, cost, technical debt, and build versus buy.

Work directly with customers, Product, and our field team. You'll join customer calls and turn feedback into the roadmap.

Raise the bar for the team through design docs, code review, and mentoring, and by showing how AI tooling can make a small team move fast without cutting corners on security.

What we're looking for

•
10+ years of experience in software development

•
A track record of building and operating production services where security and data confidentiality were hard requirements, not afterthoughts

•
Experience designing systems that hold confidential customer data end to end

•
Experience shipping software into air-gapped, disconnected, or highly restricted environments

Deep experience with cloud infrastructure on GCP and/or AWS, including IAM, KMS, networking, and infrastructure as code (Terraform)

A working knowledge of applied cryptography: envelope encryption, key management and rotation, HSM/KMS-backed keys, and signing

Proficiency with Go

Experience with AI tooling and a genuine enthusiasm for applying it to hard problems; experience building agentic systems is a plus

Strong communication skills and proficiency in English. You can explain a security model to an engineer, a security reviewer, and a customer's CISO, and you work autonomously, take initiative, and ask for help early.

A background in offensive security, vulnerability research, penetration testing, or application security, and a sense of what separates a real, exploitable finding from noise

Experience building and running arbitrary third-party code across many languages and build systems

title: INDEPENDANT CONTRACTOR OPPORTUNITY: Project Reviewer
description:
About Verra .

Verra is a global leader helping to tackle the world’s most intractable environmental and social challenges. As a mission-driven non-profit organization, Verra is committed to helping reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve livelihoods and protect natural resources across the private and public sectors. We support climate action and sustainable development with standards, tools and programs that credibly, transparently and robustly assess environmental and social impacts and enable funding for sustaining and scaling up projects that verifiably deliver these benefits. We work in any arena where we see a need for clear standards, a role for market-based mechanisms, and an opportunity to generate significant environmental and social value.

Verra manages a portfolio of standards, including the:

• Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) -- the world’s leading carbon crediting program, with more than 2000 registered projects in 80 countries, and accounting for two-thirds of all voluntary carbon market transaction volume.

• Sustainable Development Verified Impact Standard (SD VISta) -- a flexible framework for assessing and reporting on the sustainable development benefits of project-based activities.

• Climate, Community & Biodiversity (CCB) Standards -- to identify projects that simultaneously address climate change, support local communities and smallholders, and conserve biodiversity.

• Plastic Waste Reduction Program -- to enable robust impact assessment of new or scaled-up waste recovery and recycling projects around the globe.

INDEPENDANT CONTRACTOR OPPORTUNITY: Project Reviewer  

Location/Time-zone overlap: Remote worldwide, with significant overlap with US business hours for coordination of accepted project reviews. Specific coordination times and delivery deadlines will be mutually agreed for each assignment.

Primary Verra Contact: Portfolio manager for the agriculture portfolio 

Engagement type: Independent contractor providing project review services. This engagement does not provide eligibility for Verra employee benefits, paid leave, or retirement contributions, except as required by applicable law. The written contractor agreement will specify the engagement duration, scope of services, deliverables, payment terms, and each party’s responsibilities.

The   Opportunity.    

Verra  receives an increasing number of Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) project review requests, particularly under our ICVCM approved methodologies for agriculture portfolio. We are looking for experts to support project reviews under VM0032, VM0042, and VM0051 methodologies to complement our core staff’s review capacity.

  The   Role.  

Verra manages the VCS, CCBS, and SD VISta Programs and reviews project registration and verification requests as follows: 

• The project proponent (PP) submits project documents via the Verra Registry and requests registration approval or verification approval. 

• A  Verra reviewer assesses the project documents - the project description and validation report for registration requests, or the monitoring report and verification report for verification requests. The purpose of the review is to determine whether the VVB has established that the project complies with all relevant program rules to Verra ’s satisfaction.  Verra  staff produce a project review report, which contains any findings raised by Verra in respect of the project review and Verra ’s assessment conclusion (approved, pending resolution of findings, or rejected) (“project review report” (PRR)). 

•
Verra staff sends the PRR to the validation/verification body (VVB) and PP. Where there are findings, the PP/VVB must address them and resubmit the project documents after revision. 

• Iteration continues for up to three rounds of findings, at which point the findings need to be closed out if Verra is to approve the registration/verification request.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Browser (New Products)
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role

Mozilla is seeking experienced browser engineers to join a small team exploring new applications of browser technology. The work combines deep systems engineering, rapid experimentation, and close collaboration across technical disciplines.

We are looking for a browser engine specialist who enjoys turning difficult systems questions into working experiments. You will investigate browser behavior, implement changes deep in the engine, and establish which ideas produce meaningful improvements. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of engine-level investigations and implementation, working closely with the team’s technical lead.

The work suits someone who has built or substantially changed browser internals, understands the tradeoffs embedded in those systems, and enjoys applying that knowledge to unfamiliar problems. Your experiments will help inform technical direction.

What you'll do:

Design and implement experiments within browser engine subsystems. Investigate how internal data structures and execution behavior affect performance, correctness, and the interfaces exposed to developer tools.

Evaluate ways to represent and expose browser state efficiently and accurately. Identify the tradeoffs in each approach, including information loss, implementation complexity, and compatibility with dynamic web content.

Prototype engine capabilities that support reliable programmatic interaction with web content. Investigate how document structure, layout, navigation, and event handling affect correctness and performance.

Instrument browser behavior and evaluate changes against repeatable tasks. Measure performance and correctness, isolate the effect of each change, and document unsuccessful experiments as clearly as successful ones. Check that gains hold beyond the workloads used to develop the prototype.

Profile the overhead introduced by new capabilities and pursue improvements where measurements justify them. Use AI tools to accelerate coding and analysis, and verify their output through debugging, tests, and measurement.

What you'll bring:

• Deep hands-on expertise in at least one browser engine subsystem, such as DOM and Web APIs, layout and rendering, accessibility, JavaScript runtimes, or networking and process architecture. You have implemented substantial changes and can trace their effects into neighboring subsystems.

• Strong proficiency in C++ or Rust, experience navigating a large systems codebase, and practical knowledge of memory ownership, concurrency, object lifetimes, and performance debugging. You can build the JavaScript and scripting tools needed to exercise and measure your work.

• A demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar code, form a precise hypothesis, construct a useful prototype, and interpret the results. You can separate the effects of your implementation from variability in websites, workloads, or model behavior.

title: Senior Product Manager, Sales Channels
locationText: Estonia, Germany, Lithuania, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Spain
description:
About the role:
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own Printify's Sales Channels: the integrations that let merchants connect their stores and sell Printify products on Etsy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Ebay etc..
The team's mission is to enable merchants to sell through simple, powerful and scalable sales channel integrations. Every merchant's path to a first sale runs through this layer: connecting a store, publishing products, syncing listings and orders, and pushing tracking back to the channel. When it breaks, merchants lose sales and contact support; when it works well, it becomes a growth lever, for example by helping a merchant who succeeds on Etsy expand to Shopify or TikTok.
You'll lead a dedicated cross-functional squad (Engineering Manager, designer, frontend and backend engineers) and report to the Group Product Manager, Sales Experience, as one of two PMs in that group. You'll be the main product contact for our channel partners' platform and partnership teams.
What you'll do:

•
Own the sales channels roadmap

• Build and run the roadmap for sales channel integrations within the Sales Experience strategy you shape with your manager, balancing growth bets, partner-mandated changes, compliance and maintenance.

• Own the team's North Star (share of integration actions - store connection, publish attempt, publish, tracking push - that complete without failure) and the focus KPIs behind it.

• Make explicit trade-offs when unplanned partner changes arrive, and say clearly what won't be done this quarter and why.

Grow merchants across channels

• Drive multi-channel growth, starting with helping proven Etsy and Shopify merchants succeed on other channels (product shortlists, channel-specific pricing, later design guidance).

• Improve store connection and onboarding flows per channel, and run A/B tests to prove the impact before full rollout.

• Partner with Sales Hub, Lifecycle Marketing and Partnerships on channel growth programs, in-app touchpoints, email flows and co-marketing (for example creator tools for TikTok sellers).

Make integrations reliable

• Cut publishing failures through pre-publish validation that runs on every path (product page, list, bulk, API) and a support-editable error catalogue.

• Roll out store-status visibility (frozen shops, expired tokens, missing settings) across channels, measuring support-ticket impact.

• Own two-way listing and order sync, fulfilment and tracking handoff, and peak-season readiness.

Expand what the platform supports

• Bring channel features into Printify and the Public API, such as Multi-Product Listings, video upload and channel performance data.

• Prepare our APIs for AI agents and MCP-based workflows, which can only do what the API exposes.

Be the voice of Printify to channel partners

• Work directly with Etsy, Shopify and TikTok Shop platform teams: track API and policy changes, negotiate specs, pass audits and represent our merchants' needs.

• Keep compliance current, for example EU product-safety (GPSR) data, shipping and dispatch SLAs, and partner app requirements.

Run discovery and delivery with the squad

• Write PRDs, size opportunities with data (Snowflake, Looker, Amplitude), define instrumentation before build and report outcomes after launch.

• Triage escalations from Customer Support and Account Management, decide what needs a fix, and keep merchant-facing teams informed.

Your first year
First 3 months: get to know the squad, merchants, data and partner contacts. Take over the in-flight roadmap - pre-publish validation, store status, two-way listing sync and the TikTok second-channel work - and present your first roadmap.
By 6 months: extend pre-publish validation beyond Etsy to Shopify, TikTok Shop and eBay. Measure the second-channel test and recommend whether to scale it to other channel pairs. Partners and support teams know you as their product contact.
By 12 months: a multi-quarter channels roadmap, agreed with your manager,

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Packback ’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.
These few words shape everything we do at Packback from the smallest decision to the largest. Over the last decade since our company’s founding, our team has seen first-hand the power of giving students intentionally designed spaces in their learning experience to be autonomous and curious. We have also seen the incredible benefits of using AI technology to shorten feedback loops and help students revise their work before they submit.
Packback is a pedagogy partner that uses technology as a “means to an end” to shorten feedback loops for students and instructors, improve writing and critical thinking skills, and cultivate student-centered, trust-based educational learning environments.
About the Role
Packback sits at the intersection of AI and education, and we are hiring a Senior Product Manager to help decide what we build next. You will lead discovery and delivery across several product opportunities at once and bring AI-assisted prototyping and disciplined experimentation into how our product team works.
AI has made building fast. The harder question is whether we are building the right thing. You will help us test ideas quickly, read results honestly, and change course when users tell us something is not working.
You will join a small, empowered product and design team who work side by side with engineers to shape problems and own solutions together. You will have real ownership of what gets built, from first prototype to user adoption. Current work spans AI-integrated assignments, writing, discussions, and data insights, where real instructor and student feedback shapes what we build. Everything we ship exists to help students think critically, write with purpose, and learn more deeply.

Discovery and delivery

User and market research

• Talk with instructors and students regularly, and tell real demand from polite interest

• Track customer and market shifts, including competitors, and bring concise cases for adding or changing roadmap projects

AI prototyping and evaluation

• Build working prototypes with AI tools to test ideas before committing engineering time

• Evaluate our AI features: spot output that is inconsistent, generic, or wrong for the learning context, and explain how to fix it

Experimentation and outcomes

• Design experiments with a clear hypothesis, success and stop criteria agreed before work starts, and a plan for how you will read the results.

• Define outcome metrics up front, and check impact after release

• Share what works so the whole team gets better at testing ideas and measuring results

Collaboration

• Own what we build and why, and work with engineers who own more of the final call on how.

• Align stakeholders across engineering, design, and the business around product goals, and make sure everyone working on a project understands the "why"

• Partner with sales, customer success, and marketing so they can tell a compelling story about what we ship, and track adoption after launch

What success looks like

• You continually explore and shape new opportunities with real input from users and signals from the market, so we decide what to build next based on current evidence

• You ship small, finished slices of work that bring users value, on a predictable timeline

• You can measure and report on how our work influenced user behavior and business outcomes

• Every project ends with an honest readout, including when the evidence says to stop or change course

description:
About Us

Zepto is b uilding the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

It's a good moment to be doing this work. Card surcharging rules have changed, Payday Super is live, and many businesses are taking a serious look at account-to-account payments for the first time. A lot of that shift lands on our platform, and we're looking for action-oriented engineers to help build category-defining infrastructure.

Payments is a domain where the details matter. When someone's wages or a business's cash flow moves through our platform, it has to arrive correctly, every time, in seconds. Meeting that bar in a regulated industry makes for interesting engineering problems. As a Software Engineer you'll own real pieces of how we solve them, working alongside senior engineers who'll help you grow your scope quickly.

We're a remote-first team that works closely together. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, encouraged to share their thinking, and supported to grow. That culture is part of why we've been named FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies twice.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain features on our high-volume, real-time payment APIs, shipping clean, tested, observable code into a mission-critical, regulated environment.

• Work in a cross-functional team, contributing to technical designs and RFCs and turning them into well-scoped, shippable work.

• Review your peers' code and pair regularly, learning from senior engineers and sharing what you know.

• Collaborate with Platform, Security and Incident Management teams, and join our shared on-call rotation once you're up to speed.

What You'll Bring

• Solid backend foundations: Commercial experience in a backend language and API development. We work in Ruby and Go. Ruby experience is a plus, but strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter more to us than your current language.

• Clear, open communication: You share work in progress early, ask good questions, and raise risks when you see them. You ask for help early when you're stuck.

• Front-end experience (React, TypeScript) is a bonus: Plenty of our work spans the stack, from the APIs that move money to the merchant-facing UIs built on them, so engineers who can follow their work through to the UI add real value.

Your First 6 Months

• Week 1: You'll be paired with an onboarding buddy to get familiar with our domains, understand the business context across teams, and ship your first changes to production.

• Month 1: You're delivering stories within your team's domain and reviewing code with growing context. - Proficiency in Java, Kotlin or Go.

- Hands-on experience with, or a strong desire to work deeply in, technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, Kubernetes or OLAP engines.

- Experience taking complex technical challenges from initial design through production stability.

- Experience with performance tuning and systems internals, including state management, checkpointing and exactly-once semantics.

- A track record of providing technical leadership through architecture decisions, design reviews or mentorship.

- Curiosity about AI/ML infrastructure and real-time systems, with a focus on creating tangible business impact.

Translating complex policy ideas into accessible, engaging short-form video content.

Interest in public policy research and/or non-profit organizations.

Current college student or recent graduate.
Strong writing, editing and verbal communication skills.

description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking skilled Staff Software Engineers, Cloud Infrastructure to lead the buildout of our AWS foundation and our LLM platform. You will design, implement, and operate services that are scalable, reliable, and secure.

The broad scope means focus areas in LLM/ML Infra and IoT infra are strong bonus points. For ML Infra, build the stack that powers retrieval-augmented generation and application workflows built with frameworks like LangChain. Experience with IoT AWS services is a plus.

You will work closely with other engineers and product management. The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to build from first principles.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Cloud Infrastructure Setup and Maintenance

- Design, provision, and maintain AWS infrastructure using IaC tools such as AWS CDK or Terraform.

- Build CI/CD and testing for apps, infra, and ML pipelines using GitHub Actions, CodeBuild, and CodePipeline.

- Operate secure networking with VPCs, PrivateLink, and VPC endpoints. Manage IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, and audit logging.

- LLM Platform and Runtime

- Stand up and operate model endpoints using AWS Bedrock and/or SageMaker; evaluate when to use ECS/EKS, Lambda, or Batch for inference jobs.

- Build and maintain application services that call LLMs through clean APIs, with streaming, batching, and backoff strategies.

- Implement prompt and tool execution flows with LangChain or similar, including agent tools and function calling.

- RAG Data Systems and Vector Search

- Design chunking and embedding pipelines for documents, time series, and multimedia. Orchestrate with Step Functions or Airflow.

- Operate vector search using OpenSearch Serverless, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, or Pinecone. Tune recall, latency, and cost.

- Build and maintain knowledge bases and data syncs from S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and external sources.

- Evaluation, Observability, and Cost Governance

- Create offline and online eval harnesses for prompts, retrievers, and chains. Track quality, latency, and regression risk.

- Instrument model and app telemetry with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry. Build token usage and cost dashboards with budgets and alerts.

- Add guardrails, rate limits, fallbacks, and provider routing for resilience.

This position can be based out of San Francisco or New York.

OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a Product Manager to help build and grow our Payments product. Payments enables companies to move money across the world. You will own core capabilities like how businesses get onboarded, verify identity, meet compliance requirements, access payment rails, and manage liquidity over fiat and stablecoin, all through Modern Treasury. You’ll bring products to life using advanced AI tools and leading engineering and customer-facing teams.

As a Product Manager on Payments, you will work with engineering, compliance, partnerships, and customer-facing teams to ship the infrastructure that powers payments for some of the largest and fastest-growing companies in the economy. Modern Treasury is often the most critical piece of infrastructure our customers use, and the Payments product sits at the center of how money actually moves.

We are looking for someone who has built payments products before and is excited to go deep on the full lifecycle of money movement - from a customer's first onboarding moment through real-time payments at scale, across both US and international rails.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins-plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting-Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Payments Product Manager, you will own products that make up Modern Treasury's Payments offering. You will leverage AI where possible and push the envelope of what AI-enabled product execution looks like. You will be responsible for researching, designing, and delivering products related to:

- Onboarding & Compliance: You will help manage the experience of getting customers and their end users onto the platform quickly and safely. You will design onboarding flows that reduce time-to-first-payment while meeting the requirements of banks, partners, and regulators. You will also work closely with our compliance and risk teams to translate KYC, KYB, sanctions, and other regulatory requirements into product.

- Payment rails: You will go deep into the design of the rails that power payments - domestic schemes like ACH, wire, and RTP, international and cross-border rails, and emerging options including stablecoins. You will prioritize which rails to add and how to expose them in a unified, reliable way. You will also work with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure reliability and good support in cases of incidents.

- Liquidity: You will help define how funds are funded, held, and moved so that customers can settle payments efficiently. You will work on the product capabilities that give customers visibility and control over balances and liquidity across accounts and rails. In this role, you’ll interface with existing bank partners and stablecoin partners, and help scale the Payments across geographies.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- AI Fluency: You will help build and run AI-native workflows across the business. This is a hands-on, business-first role: you will identify inefficiencies, scope solutions, and use the best AI tools available to create compounding leverage for the team. You do not need to train models, but you should be fluent in applying modern AI tools to real business problems.

- Payments experience: You have built payments products before and are familiar with both US and international payments. You understand how rails work end to end and what it takes to move money reliably at scale.

- Cross-border expertise: Ideally, you have experience with both US and international cross-border payment rails, and you understand the operational and regulatory realities of moving money across borders.
